owner_authorization: Study/audit only; does not enable commerce or replace current selectors
model: Subscription source truth plus campaign-specific one-slot provenance and trust-boundary negative cases

interpretation.DENY: No grant, protected action, leak, new charge, or equivalent privilege
interpretation.ALLOW: Permitted only when all other current permission/rights checks pass
interpretation.SUSPEND: Freeze premium use without deleting source or historical record
interpretation.RESTRICT: Only bounded preissued offline read possible; no mutation/instant erase guarantee
interpretation.RETAIN: Preserve permitted authored raw data while quarantining protected dependencies
interpretation.RECONCILE: Query authoritative provider/event before taking a financial or privileged action
interpretation.IDEMPOTENT: Repeated event yields one durable effect
interpretation.NO_BILL: No unconfirmed provider execution or billing
